result:
QA-23667 passed 7/7 on the Friday rotation (Hulu account, Hulu brand, TikTok only). The report is at `results/2026-10-23/QA-23667-report.md`.

- **Date range:** The ticket's table has no date column, so I used Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2025, the same window as the 2026-10-19 run. That window has paid TikTok posts.
- **Impressions view:** Paid and Organic Impressions are "–" on all 200 rows, and Total Impressions has a value on every row.
- **Paid icons:** 124 of 200 rows in the Impressions view and 126 of 200 in the Video Views view carry the `$` icon. The count differs because the top-200 set changes with the data set.
- **Video Views view:** Paid Views are populated only on paid rows, and Organic Views are "–" on all 200 rows. Unclassified equals Total minus Paid on all 200 rows and on the aggregate row.
- **Public Data view:** There is no Paid column and no `$` icon on any of the 200 rows.
- **Stray downloads:** The browser received two CSV downloads for date ranges this case never selected. They are most likely export completions from another batch session on the same user, and I did not evaluate them.
- **Mis-click:** One click opened the Settings menu and navigated to Settings > Brands. I went back and nothing was changed.

No known bugs were open or reproduced, and no skill or REGISTRY maintenance was done, as instructed.
